concept.title: Node Health Check Operator workflow
concept.shortdesc: When a node is identified as unhealthy, the Node Health Check Operator checks how many other nodes are unhealthy. If the number of healthy nodes exceeds the amount that is specified in the minHealthy field of the NodeHealthCheck CR, the controller creates a remediation CR from the details that are provided in the external remediation template by the remediation provider. After remediation, the kubelet updates the node’s health status.

conbody.p: When the node turns healthy, the controller deletes the external remediation template.
